ruling.recommended_action: Record the RD-1 breach in the driver's file (one unexempted off-route segment, 0.77 km) but issue no refund; the fare was fixed at booking and the billed distance equals the optimal route. No account flag.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 14:19–14:22 adding 0.77 km. No RD-5 exemption: no chat exists and no pre-deviation rider consent [F7][F8]. No RD-4 exemption: no traffic incident on the route [F11] and the only speed-band records are band 4 on the AYE and CE [F9][F10], which are neither band 1–2 nor tied to the substituted optimal segment [RD-4(c)]. Therefore an unexempted deviation and an RD-1 breach, but no refund is due because the RydeX fare is a fixed quote and the billed distance equals the optimal route [F4][F6].

rejected_claims.reason: Complaint alleges the meter reached ~11 km; the fare record shows 10.8 km billed, equal to the optimal route, and RydeX is a fixed quote.
